_comment: Reviewed npm advisories that are accepted temporarily. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date; scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI on any other high/critical advisory or on an expired entry. Re-review on expiry.

advisories.reason: Next.js's internal PostCSS processes only this repository's own CSS at build time; no user-supplied CSS or source maps are ever processed. Fix requires Next 16 (breaking).
Same as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q: build-time only, trusted input.
Build-time only; stringified CSS comes from this repository, never from users.
Used only by the Prisma CLI to merge its own configuration at generate/migrate time; never with request data. Upgrade with Prisma 7.
